items.question: How many free videos can I create?
items.answer: You receive free starter credits when you sign up. Each dance video costs 10 credits. The exact number of free credits may vary, but it's enough to try multiple dance styles.

items.question: Do I need a credit card to sign up?
items.answer: No. You can sign up with just an email address and start creating immediately. We'll never charge you without your explicit consent.

items.question: Are free videos lower quality?
items.answer: No. Free videos are identical to paid ones — same HD quality, same resolution, no watermarks. There's no difference in output quality between free and paid credits.

items.question: What happens when I run out of free credits?
items.answer: You can purchase additional credits from our pricing page. We offer affordable credit packages so you can continue creating dance videos.

items.question: Is there a daily limit for free users?
items.answer: Free credits don't expire and there's no daily generation limit. You can use your free credits whenever you want, at your own pace.

items.question: Can I use free videos commercially?
items.answer: Yes. Videos generated with free credits have the same usage rights as paid videos. You can use them for social media, marketing, or any other purpose.
